BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2547.name: The Hero Lord-Dragon-the-World
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2547.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
If your Life is three or less, summon this Spirit card.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Draw a card. Then, you can set a card with Burst effect from your Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP with your "Lord-Dragon"-named Spirit, send an opposing Life to their Trash.
